# Driving (US) — Wyatt's Notes

> Free, open-access study notes. Part of the Wyatt's Notes network at https://wyattsnotes.wyattau.com

Complete US driving test preparation covering DMV written test, road test, and driving rules by state.

All pages are open-access, ad-free, and licensed under AGPLv3.

## Rules

- [US DUI and DWI Laws](https://driving-us.wyattau.com/rules/dui-laws/): Complete guide to US DUI and DWI laws including blood alcohol limits, penalties, and implied consent laws.
- [US Right-of-Way Rules](https://driving-us.wyattau.com/rules/right-of-way/): Complete guide to right-of-way rules in the US including four-way stops, roundabouts, pedestrian crossings, and emergency vehicles.
- [US Traffic Rules and Laws](https://driving-us.wyattau.com/rules/traffic-rules/): Complete guide to US traffic rules including speed limits, lane usage, turning rules, and parking regulations.

## Safe-Driving

- [US Defensive Driving Techniques](https://driving-us.wyattau.com/safe-driving/defensive-driving/): Complete guide to defensive driving techniques including space management, hazard perception, and fatigue prevention.
- [US Highway Driving Guide](https://driving-us.wyattau.com/safe-driving/highway-driving/): Complete guide to US highway driving including entering, exiting, lane changes, and highway etiquette.

## Signs

- [Guide Signs and Service Signs: Green, Blue, and Brown Road Signs](https://driving-us.wyattau.com/signs/guide-signs/): MUTCD guide signs explained: green destination and mileage signs, blue motorist services, brown recreation areas, and route markers with their numbering logic.
- [Pavement Markings: Lane Lines, Crosswalks, and Curb Colors Explained](https://driving-us.wyattau.com/signs/pavement-markings/): US pavement markings explained: yellow vs white lines, solid vs dashed, double-line rules, crosswalk styles, railroad markings, and curb color meanings.
- [Traffic Signals and Arrows: Every Light Meaning and How to Respond](https://driving-us.wyattau.com/signs/traffic-signals/): Traffic signal rules explained: solid and flashing red/yellow/green, turn arrows, protected and permissive turns, ramp metering, and how to handle signal failures.
- [US Regulatory Traffic Signs](https://driving-us.wyattau.com/signs/regulatory-signs/): Complete guide to US regulatory traffic signs including speed limits, prohibition signs, and mandatory signs with MUTCD classifications.
- [Warning Road Signs: Yellow Diamond Signs and Their Meanings](https://driving-us.wyattau.com/signs/warning-signs/): MUTCD warning signs explained: yellow diamond shapes for curves, intersections, merges, animal crossings, and road conditions, with the driving action each requires.

## State-Guides

- [California DMV Permit Test Guide 2026: Ages, Test Format, and Requirements](https://driving-us.wyattau.com/state-guides/california/): California DMV driver's license guide: permit age 15.5, 46-question written test, provisional license rules, fees, and study plan for the CA DMV knowledge exam.
- [Florida FLHSMV Permit Test Guide 2026: Ages, Test Format, and Requirements](https://driving-us.wyattau.com/state-guides/florida/): Florida learner's permit guide: TLSAE course, 50-question Class E knowledge exam, GDL night curfews, fees, and a study plan for the Florida DMV written test.
- [New York DMV Permit Test Guide 2026: Ages, Test Format, and Requirements](https://driving-us.wyattau.com/state-guides/new-york/): New York learner's permit guide: 20-question written test, 5-hour pre-licensing course, junior license rules, fees, and a study plan for the NYS DMV exam.
- [Texas DPS Permit Test Guide 2026: Ages, Test Format, and Requirements](https://driving-us.wyattau.com/state-guides/texas/): Texas DPS driver's license guide: permit at 15, 30-question knowledge test, ITD course, GDL phases, fees, and study plan for the Texas driving test.
- [US DMV State Guides: Permit and License Requirements by State](https://driving-us.wyattau.com/state-guides/): State-by-state guide to US driver's permits and licenses: minimum ages, written test formats, GDL stages, fees, and official DMV handbook links for every state.
